title: AL Bundle
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Conventional teaching gives it roughly two thirds of the ligament's cross sectional area, with a mid substance width of about 10 mm.
At 90 degrees it is the main restraint to the tibia moving backwards.
Conventional teaching places the anterior border of the bundle's footprint within about 3 mm of the cartilage edge of the medial condyle.

Conventional teaching gives the bundle a stiffness of the order of 120 newtons per millimetre and an ultimate tensile load of the order of 1,100 newtons, both larger than the posteromedial bundle by a factor of about two.
